1.title: Exam Technique and Final Review
1.text: Welcome to Module fourteen: Exam Technique and Final Review. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do five things. Technique. The product chooser. Look-alike pairs. Five questions to ask in every scenario. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Scope: All sections: time plan, product chooser, look-alike terms and decision rules. Exam format: ninety minutes and fifty to sixty multiple-choice questions. Validated against: the official Google Cloud Digital Leader exam guide.

1.title: Technique
1.text: Technique. Time. ninety minutes for fifty to sixty questions: about ninety seconds each. Order. Answer the easy ones first; mark and return to hard ones. Business first. Find the goal: speed, cost, scale, insight, security, trust. Eliminate. Remove answers that are too technical, not Google Cloud, or do not fit the goal. Prefer. Managed, serverless, scalable and least effort. Never blank. Answer every question. Exam tip: The exam tests what a product is for, not how to configure it. Learn each product in one sentence.

1.title: The product chooser
1.text: The product chooser. Store files, images, backups. Cloud Storage (Standard, Nearline, Coldline, Archive, Autoclass). Standard managed database. Cloud sequel; Postgre sequel, high performance to Alloy D B. Global relational scale. Spanner. Massive low-latency No sequel. Big table. Documents for mobile and web apps. Firestore. Serverless analytics warehouse. Big Query (M L with Big Query M L). Self-service business intelligence. Looker. Events in, processing, results out. pub sub, Dataflow, Big Query. Virtual machines. Compute Engine (spot V Ms for cheap, interruptible work). Containers at scale. G K E; across clouds G K E Enterprise. Serverless containers or event code. Cloud Run or Cloud Run functions.

1.title: The product chooser, continued
1.text: The product chooser. A P I management. Apigee. Build agents and A I apps. Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Agents for employees. Gemini Enterprise. A I infrastructure. A I Hypercomputer (G P Us, T P Us). Threat insight. Google Threat Intelligence. Risk and misconfiguration. Security Command Center. Detection and response. Google Security Operations. Protect A I prompts and answers. Model Armor. Application access without a V P N (virtual private network). Identity-Aware Proxy. Observe systems. Cloud Monitoring, Logging, Trace, Profiler, Error Reporting.

1.title: Look-alike pairs
1.text: Look-alike pairs. Hybrid and multicloud. On-premises plus cloud and more than one cloud. Zone and region. Failure domain and geographic area. I A A S, pass, sass. Most control, build apps, finished software. Data warehouse and data lake. Cleaned for analysis and raw, any type. Rehost and refactor. Move as is and rewrite for the cloud. G K E and Cloud Run. Container control and serverless containers. Authentication, authorization, auditing. Who, what may you do, what did you do.

1.title: Look-alike pairs, continued
1.text: Look-alike pairs. S L I, S L O, S L A (service level agreement). Measure, target, contract. Quota and budget. Limit use and alert on spend. Data residency and digital sovereignty. Where data is stored and who controls it under which law. Analytics, M L, gen A I, agentic A I. Describes, predicts, creates, acts.

1.title: Five questions to ask in every scenario
1.text: Five questions to ask in every scenario. What is the business goal? It points to the benefit being tested. Is it data, A I, compute, security or operations? It points to the section. Which option is managed and serverless? It is often the answer. What does the product do in one sentence? It removes look-alikes. Does it follow the shared responsibility model? Data and access are always the customer's. Exam tip: If two answers fit, pick the one with less operational work and more scale.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. A candidate has fifty-five exam questions and ninety minutes and wants a pacing plan. What is a sensible approach? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Answer the easy questions first and mark the hard ones. Answer easy items first, mark hard ones and return; never leave questions blank.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. A startup wants analytics on huge data with sequel and no servers to manage. Which choice fits best? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Big Query, a serverless data warehouse. Big Query is the serverless data warehouse for sequel analytics at scale.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. A team wants to build and govern A I agents on company data. Which product fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform is the platform to build, scale and govern A I agents.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. Which statement about shared responsibility is correct in every cloud service model? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: The customer is responsible for its own data and access. Data and access remain the customer's responsibility in every model.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. A retailer wants to move an application quickly with no code change. Which migration path fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Rehost it as it is. Rehost moves the application as it is, which is fast and needs no code change.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. A company wants to be told when spending reaches a share of its monthly plan and limit how much of a resource a project can use. Which two features are used? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Budget threshold rules and resource quota policies. Budgets alert on spending thresholds and quotas limit resource use.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. How long is the exam? Answer: ninety minutes. Question two. Which section is the smallest? Answer: Scaling with Google Cloud operations, about ten percent. Question three. What does G K E Enterprise manage? Answer: Kubernetes clusters across clouds and on-premises.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. What does Looker provide? Answer: Self-service business intelligence. Question five. What does Model Armor protect? Answer: A I prompts and responses. Question six. What does an error budget allow? Answer: The unreliability the S L O permits.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Method: goal first, section, eliminate, managed and serverless, one sentence per product. Pace: ninety minutes, fifty to sixty questions; easy first. Look-alikes: hybrid versus multicloud, zone versus region, G K E versus Cloud Run, S L I versus S L O versus S L A. Defaults: managed, scalable, least effort; customer owns data and access. If this course is helping you, please subscribe to the channel and hit the bell icon, so you get a notification when the next video is out. That completes the course. Good luck with the exam.
